_help: Settings for the Highlights card on the Overview. Edit freely; the dashboard picks changes up on the next deploy.

launchKeywords: competitor posts naming any of these are called out. Matching ignores case and works on whole words or phrases, so 'won' does not match inside 'wonderful'. End a keyword with * to match any word starting with it: 'commission*' matches commission, commissioned, commissioning.
volumeMultiple: a page posting this many times (or more) its usual weekly number of posts in the last 7 days of the range.
postMultiple: a post getting this many times (or more) its page's average likes + comments. minLikesComments stops tiny numbers (3 vs 1) from counting.
followerJumpPct: a page gaining this many per cent (or more) followers in a week.
